question: Which exact 3.101.036 firmware entry submits a caller-owned dynamic L2CAP connection request to the L2CAP owner FSM?
callsite_evidence: Exact IDA sub_C7ED544 forwards its sole request argument to owner dword_20137B0C through sub_C7D33C0 and worker sub_C7E94FC.
Worker sub_C7E94FC consumes the recovered request fields including address/config/options and invokes the request callback at offset +20.
The previous 0x0C7ED48C entry takes no request argument and queues sub_C7EA764 L2CAP subsystem cleanup.
control_flow_evidence: 0x0C7ED544 is an independent Thumb function entry; callable address is 0x0C7ED545.
ownership_analysis: The caller-owned request is passed to the owner queue and consumed by the worker/callback lifecycle on accepted insertion.
unsafe_assumptions: The request layout and callback ABI are enforced by target-private compile-time constants.
Call only after dword_20137B0C owner initialization.
recommended_probe: Submit one AVDTP PSM 0x0019 request and verify callback event progression and negotiated CID/MTU.
